name: Moltiply Group S.p.A.
summary: Moltiply Group S.p.A. operates as a holding company in the financial services industry in Italy, Germany, and internationally. It operates through Moltiply BPO&Tech (BPO) and Mavriq (Broking) divisions. The Mavriq Division operates in the online comparison and intermediation of utility contracts, insurance products, bank products, and e-commerce offers. This segment also provides Mavriq Telco & Energy, an online comparison and intermediation of electricity, gas and telco contracts; Mavriq Insurance, an online comparison and intermediation of insurance products; Mavriq Banking, an online comparison and intermediation of credit and other banking products; and Mavriq Shopping, a comparison shop…
